snippet.title: ECW Born to be Wired OPEN BETA Intro
snippet.description:
This project was built with support on Patreon and is now free for everyone.
https://www.patreon.com/posts/quick-links-137543185?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_creator&utm_content=join_link

ECW BORN TO BE WIRED Changes Since NM+V3
New match types and new rules added.
Multiman cage matches, barbed wire matches, 5 count pin and 10 count TKO.
Story dialogue has been altered to include ECW, custom NWA story by homeyohmy.
New in game features:
Rumble toss with C-right.
Front grapple doomsday.
Cage wall grapples.
Flying attack off of cage top.
Weapon Grapples.
Flying Attacks with weapons.
Lay opponent on portable tables (even stack two opponents).
Flying attack off of stationary tables and loading truck.
Expanded wrestler select stable size. 16 characters per stable.
Tons of new moves.
All new sounds.
Possibly more that I'm forgetting.
